phases.message: I'm the finance manager of Quillfern Community Kitchen. Start in Grantpoint, our conditional grants: read each grant and its progress. Read, and do not book anything yet.
Binderwell has our gift and grant agreements and the board's minutes. Read every page.
Ledgerwren is our books. Read the accounting policy, every page of our funds and gifts, every page of the ledger entries, and the releases already booked.
Donorsheaf has our gifts since July. Read every page.
Postwren is our mail. Read every message and note what each attachment is. Don't reply to anyone.
Fundergate is where our funders take reports. Read what each funder asks and the reports we have already sent.
Back in Ledgerwren, book a release for each fund or grant whose terms are met today, for the amount its terms let us release. Book nothing where the terms are not met.

Back in Fundergate, send each funder whose agreement asks for it the report of a release already booked, if we haven't already sent it. Don't reply to anyone. Then tell me, for each fund and grant, whether you released it and for how much and why, which reports you sent, and what you left alone.

policy.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Ledgerwren holds Quillfern Community Kitchen's books. The fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June; the year to 30 June 2026 is closed and audited, and this is the year to 30 June 2027. A release is a reclassification: an entry RE-n that moves an amount from net assets with donor restrictions to net assets without. The kitchen's accounting policy follows FASB ASC 958 as ASU 2016-14 and ASU 2018-08 amended it. Topics: releases, purpose, time, conditions, simultaneous, designations, reports, help.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026. A release is booked when a donor's restriction has been met: the stipulated purpose fulfilled, the stipulated time passed, or both (ASC 958-205-45-9). It is booked for the amount the terms let go, not the face value of the gift: a purpose met in part is released in part. Book it with book_release, naming the fund or grant by its id (RF-n or CG-n) and the amount in dollars. A release moves an amount between classes; it makes no revenue and moves no cash. The entry is numbered RE-n and appears in the releases read.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026. A cost counts toward a purpose restriction only if the donor's agreement allows it; a cost the agreement excludes does not count even when it is coded to the fund. A restriction to buy a long-lived asset expires when the asset is placed in service (ASC 958-205-45-12), not when it is ordered or part-paid. The date is the one on the kitchen's sign-off or delivery document in Binderwell. Spending that has not met the purpose leaves the restriction in place.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026. A time restriction expires when the stipulated date arrives (ASC 958-205-45-9), not before. The date is the one in the agreement as amended: an amendment signed by the donor and by the kitchen replaces the date it changes, whether it moves the date earlier or later. Amendments reach the kitchen on paper; they are logged in Postwren until Binderwell is brought up to date, so Binderwell can be behind the mail.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026. A condition is a barrier that must be overcome plus a right of return or release (ASC 958-605-25-5A). Until the barrier is overcome the money is not in net assets with donor restrictions at all: cash received is a refundable advance (958-605-25-5F). Whether a barrier can be met in part is read from the agreement. Allowable costs incurred, a dollar of match raised, or a milestone with its own installment are met in part and recognised to that extent (958-605-55-17 and 55-21). A barrier that unlocks the whole grant at once, earned in full or not at all, is not met in part: until it is met, nothing is recognised.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026. The kitchen has elected the policy of ASC 958-605-45-4A and 45-4B for grants that were conditional: when a condition is met and the grant's purpose is spent in the same period, the part recognised is reported at once as support without donor restrictions, in one release entry. Release such a grant with book_release, naming its CG id and the amount recognised this time, not the cumulative amount. An amount already released by an earlier RE entry is not released again.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026. A board designation is the board's own limit on unrestricted money (ASC 958 glossary: self-imposed limits). It is not a donor restriction, and nothing is released from it. A gift the donor requires to be held in perpetuity is a permanent restriction: its corpus is never released. Only income the board appropriates under the gift agreement can be spent, and it is released when that appropriation meets any purpose or time the agreement adds.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026. A funder's own agreement says whether it wants a report on a release and by when; Fundergate lists what each asks. A report is filed from a release already booked in Ledgerwren, named by its RE id, with the funder's id. A report is filed once. An individual donor is not a funder: Fundergate takes no report for a gift from a person.
Today is Friday 9 October 2026. The finance manager books releases and files funder reports. An outside firm is engaged only by a vote of the board, never by a reply to an offer.
